jānua, jānuae f.

noun, first declension

Other words

  • ōstium, ōstiī n. — door, doorway, opening

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 123; Traupman 305; Traupman 306

  • valvae, valvārum f. pl. — folding doors, the two leaves of a door

    noun, first declension, plural · also used · classical · Cic. Div. 1.74; Verr. 2.4.94 (Lewis & Short s.v. valva); Traupman 123, 125; Traupman 305

  • forēs, forium f. pl. — double doors, folding doors

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Traupman 305

    Usually plural, of the two leaves of a door; the singular foris is one leaf.

See also front door, back door, door handle, bolt the door, threshold, doorpost, lintel, window, gate, house.
